name: reactive-resume-v5
description: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder for creating, updating, and sharing resumes. This v5 template requires a reachable PostgreSQL database.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent local upload storage used when S3 is not configured.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Public URL for this instance. Use the external HTTPS URL when behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Replace POSTGRES_HOST with the reachable host name or IP of your Postgres container/server.

variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Authentication secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH
variables.description: Container path for local upload storage.
